artworks.title: Ell me plait beaucoup ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two men and one woman. The two men are positioned closely together on the left side, each wearing a top hat and dark suits. Their faces have exaggerated features, one with a large nose and both with pronounced chins and bushy sideburns. Both men are facing towards the right, appearing engaged in conversation. They are dressed in 19th-century attire, with one wearing a scarf. A woman is partially visible in the background on the right side, with long, braided hair and a shawl over her shoulders. The background is a simple sketch without detailed scenery, set in a newspaper-style format with text above and below the illustration.

artworks.title: Le morceau qu'on obligé d'avalier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals, with three adults standing and one child playing the piano. The adults are dressed in formal attire from an older era and have defined facial features with exaggerated expressions. The child is seated on a stool, playing the piano and focusing on sheet music. The background has textured shading.

artworks.title: En train de charmer toute une société ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, a person stands with raised hands, appearing to speak or sing. The individual has distinctive facial features with an open mouth, expressive eyes, and mid-length dark hair brushed back. The person wears a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie. Two seated women listen nearby. The background includes loosely sketched lines indicating an audience and hanging decorations. The setting seems to be indoors with decorative lighting fixtures above.

artworks.title: Ou l'on reconnait ... un ancien pharmacien
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man bending down to interact with a dog on a leash held by another figure. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic style, likely using charcoal or ink. The man is extending a hand towards the small dog. The figures and buildings are drawn in a lively way, with a sense of action in the man's pose. In the background, there are urban elements like buildings that create a sense of location and depth.

artworks.title: Emotion du docteur Véron ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man climbing a tree. The man's body is shown from the side, including his torso, legs, and one arm wrapped around the tree. His face is turned towards the trunk of the tree, with a side profile visible. He is dressed in a jacket and checkered pants. One of his shoes can be seen as it seems to lose grip on the tree trunk, while a hat is depicted falling through the air next to him. On the ground near the base of the tree, there is a small dog with its mouth open. The background features a simple landscape with a few trees. The image is monochromatic, rendered in shades of black on a sepia-toned paper.

artworks.title: Un service ... pas facile a rendre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small group of people trying to hold onto a rope from an airborne hot air balloon. The scene shows two figures, one holding onto a string attached to a floating hot air balloon, being pulled slightly forward as they struggle against the force. The balloon is drifting diagonally upwards from the left to the right side of the drawing. The figures include a small person standing still and another being pulled along the ground, with their hat flying off and a bundle or basket falling to the ground. In the background, there is a slightly shaded landscape with trees and a land horizon.

artworks.title: La gare du chemin de fer de Boulogne
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene at a railway station. The image depicts figures with distorted facial features and attire engaging in conversation and activities typical of a railway station setting. The figures have large heads and exaggerated expressions, emphasizing the satirical nature of the scene. There are arches in the background indicating the station's architecture, and the station is bustling with a crowd composed of different characters, each with their distinct style. A small dog is present in the foreground. The figures are clothed in 19th-century attire, complete with top hats and formal wear.

artworks.title: Arrivée a une station
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows many people depicted in caricature style. They are walking towards the right side of the image. The faces have exaggerated features, with prominent noses. The individuals are wearing period attire such as long coats, shawls, top hats, and bonnets. One man is wearing a checkered suit and white hat. There is a sign that reads "STATION" in the background. The setting includes posts and partial partitions, possibly indicating a railway station.

artworks.title: Une maitresse a l'opera
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted from the waist upwards, engaged in conversation. Both men are standing side by side, facing each other. The man on the left has a smooth face with distinct features, such as a prominent nose, and his hair is short and neatly combed back. The man on the right has defined facial features and short, dark hair styled with curls around the ears. He holds an object resembling a lorgnette in his right hand. Both are dressed in formal attire: dark jackets and white shirts with high collars. The background illustrates an interior with an audience and architectural elements, suggesting a theater or opera house atmosphere. Text is printed above and below the image.

artworks.title: Ce qu'on est convenue d'appeler un rafraichissement
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of two scenes of social interaction inside an establishment. The upper scene shows figures around a table with a bowl, displaying exaggerated expressions and gestures. A title above it reads "PARIS QUI BOIT," with a caption "Ce qu'on est convenu d'appeler un rafraichissement." 

The lower scene features two figures conversing at a counter, exchanging a cup, with another figure seated nearby. A large barrel or container in the background suggests a place providing beverages. The caption "Chez Paul Niquet" indicates a specific establishment. Strong contrasts and expressive lines in the drawing highlight Parisian life connected to drinking establishments.

artworks.title: En valachie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking together. The first man has exaggerated facial features, wears a large hat, and carries a bagpipe and thurible. The second man also has exaggerated facial features, wears a tall hat with an animal pelt, and carries a bag and a crucifix. In the background, there is a simple sketch of a church with a dome and a cross.

artworks.title: S'étant placé sur une pente dangereuse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a caricature of a person leaning forward on a steep incline. The figure has exaggerated facial features with a distinctive chin, large nose, and pronounced brow. They are bald on top with wavy hair on the sides, wearing a large crown and a dark, flowing garment with long sleeves. The figure's hand is holding onto the crown as they look downwards, with billowing fabric behind them. In the background, there is a barren landscape with an animal on the right side. The hill or rock of the incline is detailed with sharp lines to emphasize its steepness. Text and numbers are visible around the border, indicating it is part of a publication.

artworks.title: Costumes russes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a cartoon illustration showing two individuals in full body view. The persons are depicted standing side by side with exaggerated military uniforms. The individual on the left is standing rigidly straight, wearing a tall, cylindrical hat with an ornate design, and a long coat with a white X-shaped decoration across the chest. The second individual on the right is bent forward, wearing a large, elaborate helmet with a plume and a decorative design. Their facial features are not visible due to the shadow cast by the helmet, but a mustache is noticeable. The clothing worn is reminiscent of historic military attire, featuring long skirts and ornate details. An eagle with spread wings is perched atop the helmet. Behind the figures, large, draped curtains form the background.

artworks.title: Tableau ... de l'empire de russie
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing features three figures engaged in an activity. Two figures on the left are holding whips with raised arms, while a third figure on the right crouches with arms raised. The scene conveys movement as the whips curve through the air. The figures are wearing attire reminiscent of a past era, with dramatic body positions and expressions. The backdrop is minimal, emphasizing the interaction between the figures. The composition focuses on the narrative and contrast between the figures' actions and postures.

artworks.title: Se passant la fantaisie de faire naufrager ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a helmeted figure interacting with a bowl of small ships in front of a map. The image depicts a muscular figure wearing armor, intently looking at a bowl containing miniature ships floating on water. The helmet is adorned with an elaborate emblem on top. To the right, there is a map labeled "MER NOIRE" and "SEBASTOPOLD" in black print. The text below the drawing reads "Se passant la fantaisie de faire naufrager la flotte Anglo-Francaise."

artworks.title: Un inspecteur général russe
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish character commanding a line of identical skeletal soldiers. The character has sharp facial features, a tall hat with a plume, and is dressed in a military uniform. Their arm is extended outward as if giving an order, holding a whip or baton. The soldiers are lined up in front of the character, extending into the distance. The background is minimal, with a flat ground.

artworks.title: Deux Grands-Ducs Lachés ... sur Sébastopol
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rotund figure holding a birdcage, with two owls flying away. The figure is exaggerated, providing a humorous or satirical tone typical of caricature drawings. The detailed line work captures the textures of the figure's clothes and the feathers of the flying owls. The owls appear to be emerging freely, contrasting with the static posture of the central figure. The setting is minimalistic, focusing on the interaction between the subject and the owls.

artworks.title: Continuant ... Le divertissement des tables tournantes ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men seated at a table. The man on the left has a mustache and a visible facial structure. The man in the middle has wide eyes and a surprised expression. The man on the right is in profile with his eyes closed. All three men are dressed in dark suits. The background features text and patterns.

artworks.title: Vue prise sur n'importe quel boulevard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lively scene inside a cafe or bar. The drawing depicts several patrons seated closely together. On the left side, a figure is seated with an arm draped over the back of a chair. Another figure on the right appears to be holding a drink and a napkin. Both individuals are depicted with exaggerated expressions and postures. In the background, more figures are gathered around a table, some engaged in conversation or drinking. The use of shading and line work effectively conveys the texture and depth of the scene.

artworks.title: C'est bizarre ... été
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in conversation. One man is seated on a stone or mound, wearing a formal suit with a cane in his right hand and a top hat beside him. The other man is standing facing him, wearing a long coat, top hat, and a patterned waistcoat. The background depicts minimalist representations of trees and hills.

artworks.title: La pluie tombe déja comme ça depuis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures with crutches walking alongside a dog. The figures are conversing as they lean towards each other. Each figure wears a hat, short pants, and a jacket. The background shows a barren outdoor landscape. The dog walks ahead of them, appearing focused. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style, capturing clothing details and ground texture. The drawing conveys motion and interaction between the figures and the dog in an environment that appears brisk or rainy, as suggested by the angled lines intersecting the image.

artworks.title: A Flourens, la jeunesse reconnaissante!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stone bust on a pedestal with an engraving dedicated to 'A Flourens'. On either side of the pedestal, two figures are reacting to the bust. The figure on the left is wearing a bowler hat and extending one hand toward the bust while holding a cane. The figure on the right is raising a hat toward the bust, with various articles scattered around their feet. The scene appears to convey a humorous encounter, possibly a cultural or political commentary. The drawing has strong lines and shading, typical of 19th-century caricatures.

artworks.title: A Naples: Délégués de la commission ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing in the foreground. The man on the left leans against a wall with both hands resting on a stick or cane, facing the other man. He has a bearded face and is wearing a cap, a sleeveless top, and knee-length trousers. The man on the right stands upright, gripping a stick with both hands, also wearing a cap, a loose-fitting shirt, and cropped pants. In the background, two men are seen bending over as they drag another person across the ground. The setting is outdoors, with buildings, a mountain, and a sky with sparse clouds in the background. A low fence or railing separates the foreground from the rest of the landscape.

artworks.title: Le nouveau polichinelle napolitan
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of puppet-like figures on a stage. The drawing features exaggerated caricatures of the figures, characterized by bulbous noses and oversized costumes. The central figure is holding a club and poised over another figure at the edge of the stage. The stage is framed with a heavy curtain. The style uses bold, sketchy lines and emphasizes the expressions and posture of the figures, conveying a sense of satirical commentary.
